title: 8. Exam 3 Format Preview
objective: Study-guide review — ICCS423 v2 — L22: CTF Skills & Exam 3 Prep: 8. Exam 3 Format Preview.

items: Multi-source logs — you'll receive a packet of logs from different systems (firewall, auth, EDR, email gateway). Reconstruct the attack timeline.
Malware hash — given a SHA-256, look it up on VirusTotal and report:
Damage assessment — based on logs + malware capability, describe what was likely accessed/exfiltrated/destroyed (per CIA: Confidentiality, Integrity, Availability)

blocks.text: ``` Section 1 — Attack Timeline [chronological log-correlated events in UTC]
Section 2 — Malware Hash Analysis Hash: <sha256> Detection: <X/Y engines> Family: <name> ATT&CK: <T#### list> Behaviors: <bullet list>
Section 3 — Damage Assessment Confidentiality: <what data was accessed> Integrity: <what was modified> Availability: <what was disrupted>

items: Don't skip damage assessment + recommendations (often weighted heavily)
